issues.where: both cotyledons and the stem of the central seedling
issues.what: the cotyledons read as thick, smooth, uniform olive-green plastic spoons with no epidermal texture and almost no light passing through them against the sun, mounted on a dead-straight, uniform-width cylindrical stem
issues.fix: add cellular surface micro-relief, subtle venation and color variation, stronger warm subsurface scattering through backlit leaves, and slight organic taper and curvature to the stem

issues.where: crop 1 and crop 3, central emerging leaf bud and cotyledon junction
issues.what: the emerging true leaf is a flat diamond-shaped card with knife-sharp straight upper edges, painted-on dark symmetrical vein lines, a flat-capped stem junction, and thick rigid spike hairs that poke through the base of the right cotyledon
issues.fix: give the young leaf three-dimensional curl, lamina thickness, raised translucent veins, an organic petiole transition, and fine curved hairs that do not intersect neighboring leaves

issues.where: crop 1, crop 3, and crop 4, dew on the cotyledon surfaces and rims
issues.what: dew on the cotyledon faces and rims renders as isolated 1-to-4-pixel clipped pure-white jagged specks and stair-stepped rim pixels rather than rounded refractive water droplets
issues.fix: model resolved, variably sized water droplets with wetting contact angles, smooth internal refraction, and filtered highlights free of pixel fireflies

issues.where: crop 2 and crop 5, split seed hull on the left and adjacent in-focus soil clods
issues.what: the striped seed hull sits inside the sharp focal zone on a crisp dirt clod yet looks blurry and low-resolution with stair-stepped rim aliasing and no dirt or moisture, while nearby in-focus soil clods show hard angular polygonal facets with glossy plastic-like highlights
issues.fix: match the seed hull texture resolution and focal sharpness to the sharp zone, weather and seat it into damp soil with contact shadow, and replace faceted glossy clods with granular, porous soil displacement

issues.where: crop 2, crop 4, and crop 5, backlit stem edges and stem base in the soil
issues.what: hairs along both backlit stem edges collapse into a jagged 1-pixel-wide bright stipple fringe, and the bright green stem plunges into the soil gap without a root-collar transition, clinging soil grains, or contact shadow darkening
issues.fix: render fine, anti-aliased translucent stem hairs and add contact ambient occlusion, dampness, and adhered soil particles where the stem meets the soil

issues.where: left and right grass tufts and the dew drops along their blades
issues.what: the grass blades are stiff repeated ribbons with uniform painted-on pale stripes, lined with evenly spaced spherical bead droplets including a perfect sphere balanced on the upper-right blade tip without gravity sag or wetting meniscus
issues.fix: vary grass blade geometry, rib relief, and color, and distribute droplets irregularly with realistic surface-tension contact shapes and gravity-pulled tip drops

issues.where: crop 9, radial sun streaks and the distant right horizon
issues.what: the right horizon is a ruler-straight featureless flat band reading like a flat backdrop, and narrow symmetrical starburst spokes radiate from the sun only downward across the ground band while vanishing in the sky above the horizon
issues.fix: break up the flat horizon with subtle distant terrain and atmospheric haze, and use physically consistent full-aperture optical bloom and glare around the sun

issues.where: crop 2 and crop 5, out-of-focus mid-ground soil behind the stem
issues.what: small gritty speckled bokeh clusters appear in the out-of-focus soil highlights behind the stem and right clod
issues.fix: increase depth-of-field sampling and clamp sub-pixel specular spikes in the mid-ground soil before defocus

issues.where: crop 8 and crop 10, blurred skyline and sky gradient
issues.what: fine high-frequency render grain is visible when inspecting the out-of-focus hill silhouette and sky gradients past delivery size
issues.fix: apply gentle chroma-preserving denoising or higher sample counts in the out-of-focus background and sky
